import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import re

# Disable progress bars and warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv"))

# Store original values for submission
test_comments_original = test_df["Comment"].copy()
test_dates_original = test_df["Date"].copy()


def clean_text_for_features(text):
    """Clean text while preserving semantic meaning for feature extraction."""
    if isinstance(text, str):
        if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
            text = text[1:-1]
        # Normalize whitespace and newlines
        text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("  ", " ")
        text = text.replace("\t", " ")
        return text
    return str(text)


def count_second_person_prnouns(text):
    """Count second person pronouns (you, your, yours) - common in direct insults."""
    text_lower = text.lower()
    second_person_patterns = [
        r"\byou\b",
        r"\byours\b",
        r"\byour\b",
        r"\byou\.?$",
    ]
    count = 0
    for pattern in second_person_patterns:
        count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    return count


def count_first_person_prnouns(text):
    """Count first person pronouns (I, me, my) - common in self-referential complaints."""
    text_lower = text.lower()
    first_person_patterns = [
        r"\bi\b",
        r"\bme\b",
        r"\bmy\b",
        r"\bmine\b",
    ]
    count = 0
    for pattern in first_person_patterns:
        count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    return count


def count_negative_intensifiers(text):
    """Count negative or intensifying words common in insults."""
    text_lower = text.lower()
    negative_patterns = [
        r"\bnot\b",
        r"\bnever\b",
        r"\bnothing\b",
        r"\bno\b",
        r"\bwhy\b",
        r"\bwtf\b",
        r"\bwtf\b",
    ]
    count = 0
    for pattern in negative_patterns:
        count += len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
    return count


def count_capitalized_words(text):
    """Count all-caps words (often used for emphasis in insults)."""
    text_lower = text.lower()
    words = text.split()
    return sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)


def get_special_chars_ratio(text):
    """Calculate ratio of special characters to total characters."""
    text_clean = re.sub(r"\w+", "", text)
    special_char_ratio = len(text_clean) / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0
    return special_char_ratio


def get_short_word_ratio(text):
    """Calculate ratio of very short words (1-2 chars)."""
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) == 0:
        return 0
    short_words = [w for w in words if len(w) <= 2]
    return len(short_words) / len(words)


def get_punctuation_density(text):
    """Calculate density of punctuation marks."""
    punctuation = r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]"
    matches = len(re.findall(punctuation, text))
    return matches / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0


def get_exclamation_ratio(text):
    """Calculate ratio of exclamation marks (emphasis in insults)."""
    exclamation_count = text.count("!")
    return (
        exclamation_count / text.count(" ")
        if text.count(" ") > 0
        else exclamation_count
    )


def get_question_ratio(text):
    """Calculate ratio of question marks (rhetorical questions in insults)."""
    question_count = text.count("?")
    return question_count / text.count(" ") if text.count(" ") > 0 else question_count


def extract_text_features(text):
    """Extract multiple text-based features including word-level patterns."""
    text = str(text) if text else ""
    if len(text) == 0:
        return (
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
        )

    text_lower = text.lower()

    # Basic counts
    word_count = len(text.split())
    char_count = len(text)
    line_count = text.count("\n") + 1

    if word_count == 0 or char_count == 0:
        return (
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
            np.nan,
        )

    # Character-level features
    char_count = len(text)

    # Word length statistics
    word_lengths = [len(w) for w in text.split()]
    avg_word_length = np.mean(word_lengths)
    max_word_length = max(word_lengths)
    min_word_length = min(word_lengths)

    # Word ratio features
    short_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in word_lengths if w < 3) / len(word_lengths)
    long_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in word_lengths if w >= 6) / len(word_lengths)

    # Pronoun features
    second_person_count = count_second_person_prnouns(text)
    first_person_count = count_first_person_prnouns(text)
    second_person_ratio = second_person_count / word_count
    first_person_ratio = first_person_count / word_count
    second_person_first_person_ratio = second_person_count / max(first_person_count, 1)

    # Intensity/emotion features
    negative_intensifier_count = count_negative_intensifiers(text)
    negative_intensifier_ratio = negative_intensifier_count / word_count
    all_caps_words = count_capitalized_words(text)

    # Emphasis/punctuation features
    special_chars_ratio = get_special_chars_ratio(text)
    punctuation_density = get_punctuation_density(text)
    exclamation_ratio = get_exclamation_ratio(text)
    question_ratio = get_question_ratio(text)

    # Line features
    words_per_line = word_count / line_count if line_count > 0 else 0

    # Capitalization features
    upper_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
    lower_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.islower())
    total_alphabetic = upper_count + lower_count
    upper_ratio = upper_count / total_alphabetic if total_alphabetic > 0 else 0
    all_caps_ratio = all_caps_words / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0

    return (
        char_count,
        word_count,
        avg_word_length,
        max_word_length,
        min_word_length,
        short_word_ratio,
        long_word_ratio,
        second_person_count,
        first_person_count,
        second_person_ratio,
        first_person_ratio,
        second_person_first_person_ratio,
        negative_intensifier_count,
        negative_intensifier_ratio,
        all_caps_words,
        special_chars_ratio,
        punctuation_density,
        exclamation_ratio,
        question_ratio,
        upper_ratio,
        all_caps_ratio,
        words_per_line,
    )


# Preprocessing - clean text for feature extraction
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text_for_features)
test_df_for_train = test_df.copy()
test_df_for_train["Comment"] = test_df_for_train["Comment"].apply(
    clean_text_for_features
)


# Extract text-based features
train_features = []
for comment in train_df["Comment"]:
    features = extract_text_features(comment)
    train_features.append(features)

test_features = []
for comment in test_df_for_train["Comment"]:
    features = extract_text_features(comment)
    test_features.append(features)

train_feature_array = np.array(train_features, dtype=float)
test_feature_array = np.array(test_features, dtype=float)

# Handle NaN values
train_feature_array = np.nan_to_num(
    train_feature_array, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0
)
test_feature_array = np.nan_to_num(test_feature_array, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)


# Character n-gram features (including char2 for better profanity detection)
char_vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=5000, lowercase=True
)

X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df_for_train["Comment"])


# Combine character n-gram features with text features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_char.toarray(), train_feature_array])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_char.toarray(), test_feature_array])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values


# Train validation split (must not use validation data for final model)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)


# Train LightGBM model with same hyperparameters as previous solution
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=42, verbose=-1, n_jobs=-1
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)


# Validate on held-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")


# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]


# Create submission with exact original Comment values and correct column order
submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["Insult"] = y_test_pred
submission["Comment"] = test_comments_original
submission["Date"] = test_dates_original

# Ensure column order matches sample submission exactly
submission = submission[["Insult", "Comment", "Date"]]


# Save submission
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")


# Verify submission integrity
if len(submission) == len(test_df):
    if (submission["Comment"].values == test_comments_original.values).all():
        print("Submission verified: Comment values match test set")
    else:
        print("WARNING: Submission Comment values don't match!")
else:
    print(
        f"WARNING: Row count mismatch. Submission: {len(submission)}, Test: {len(test_df)}"
    )
